feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: 25 years later, Americans pause to remember the lives lost on 9/11
entry.summary: Twenty-five years ago, nearly 3,000 people were killed in the 9/11 attacks. Today, Americans are honoring the lives lost and reflecting on the aftermath of that tragic day.

entry.title: John Avlon, Rudy Giuliani's chief speechwriter during 9/11 attacks, recounts that day
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin asks John Avlon, who was chief speechwriter to New York Mayor Rudy Giuliani at the time of the 9/11 attacks, for his memories of that day.

entry.title: These Michigan swing voters are bracing for higher prices from trade war with Canada
entry.summary: President Trump's tariff standoff with Canada is rankling some key voters ahead of this year's midterm elections.

entry.title: Trump administration allows TPS to continue for Salvadorans – for now
entry.summary: The Trump administration declined this week to terminate TPS for Salvadorans, even though it has done so for people from other countries like Haiti and Syria. But it also hasn't said whether it will extend the protection in the future.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Today marks 25 years since the 9/11 attacks, Trump and Vance issue plea for Americans to vote Republican in last night of convention, Trump-backed redistricting map effectively blocked in Missouri.

entry.title: Morning Edition hosts recount their experience covering 9/11 in D.C. and New York
entry.summary: Morning Edition hosts Steve Inskeep and Michel Martin both reported from the Sept. 11 terror attack sites. Steve recalls reporting outside the Pentagon and Michel recounts her time in lower Manhattan.

entry.title: Friday's inflation report could help Fed decide whether to raise interest rates
entry.summary: Consumer prices rose 3.4% percent last month from a year ago, the same as it was in July and matching expectations. Gas prices were among the biggest risers.

entry.title: Fintech companies are applying to become banks. Here's what it takes to become one
entry.summary: Many financial technology companies are applying to become banks. The Indicator finds out what it takes to go through this process and what benefits come with a bank charter.

entry.title: Nancy Pelosi reflects on how the world has changed since 9/11
entry.summary: The last person NPR's Steve Inskeep interviewed before the 9/11 attacks was an up-and-coming Democratic lawmaker named Nancy Pelosi. Now, they discuss how the world changed after that day.

entry.title: Vance, Trump urge Americans to support Republicans on last night of convention
entry.summary: Vice President Vance delivered remarks at the final night of the Republican Midterm Convention, as President Trump relished his last convention as the Republican Party's dominant leader.
